title: NIT Rourkela Notification 2026 - Apply Offline for Project Associate I Posts
description: National Institute of Technology Rourkela (NIT Rourkela) has released a notification for the recruitment of various Project Associate I Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in B.E/ B.Tech or M.E/ M.Tech can use this chance and apply for the NIT Rourkela Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts.
